result.title: ci: cancel superseded CI Gate runs, normalize the timeout
result.body:
Adds a `concurrency:` group to the `CI Gate` workflow, and normalizes
`timeout-minutes`.

**Concurrency.** Push a new commit to a PR and the running gate job keeps going.
It resolved its target SHA at startup, so it spends the rest of its life polling
for runs on a commit nobody cares about any more, holding a runner the whole
time. `cancel-in-progress` kills it when its replacement starts. The group keys
on `github.ref`, which for a `pull_request` event is `refs/pull/N/merge` — so
it scopes per PR and never cancels across PRs.

Three repos (dirsql, willfire, github-data-file-fetcher) already had this from
an earlier rollout. This brings the other eleven in line.

**Timeout.** Settling the fleet on a single rule: 20 minutes, raised only where
the measured slowest non-gate `pull_request` run gets close. The only repo that
qualifies is putitoutthere at 16 minutes, which stays at 30. dirsql, willfire
and github-data-file-fetcher drop from 45 to 20 — their slowest observed runs
are 7 minutes, under 1 minute, and none-at-all respectively, so 45 just meant a
wedged gate burned twice as long before anyone noticed.

No change to gating behavior.

result.patch:
@@ -4,6 +4,11 @@ on:
   pull_request:
     types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
 
+concurrency:
+  # A superseded gate run polls a stale SHA until it finishes. Cancel it.
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
 permissions:
   actions: read
   contents: read

@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 ## [Unreleased]
 
 ### Changed
+- CI: the `pr-monitor` gate workflow gains a `concurrency:` group with `cancel-in-progress`. A gate job resolves its target SHA at startup, so pushing a new commit left the old run polling for runs on a superseded commit and holding a runner until it finished. Keyed on `github.ref` (`refs/pull/N/merge` for a `pull_request` event), so it scopes per PR
 - CI: `pr-monitor` is pinned to `thekevinscott/pr-monitor@v1` instead of `clankerbot/pr-monitor@v1`. The old path resolved only through GitHub's owner-rename redirect, and a different account has since claimed the name `clankerbot` — once it holds a repo called `pr-monitor` the redirect is superseded and the workflow would run a stranger's action with our workflow token. Also drops the `job-name` and `excluded-jobs` inputs, neither of which the current action declares; it compares workflow runs rather than check runs, so Netlify's external checks were never in scope for exclusion
 - CI: the `pr-monitor` gate job now declares the permissions the action actually uses (`actions: read` to list workflow runs, `contents: read`, `pull-requests: read` for willfire's prediction). The previous `permissions: checks: read` block set every unlisted scope to `none`, which is latent while this repo is public — a starved token still reads public data — and an outage the day it is not. Adds `timeout-minutes: 20`: the action has no timeout of its own, so the caller's job timeout is the only backstop, and without it a predicted run that never dispatches would hang until GitHub's 6-hour limit

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --extra dev

      - name: Build package
        run: uv run just build

name: Changelog

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Skip for dependabot PRs and PRs with skip-changelog label
    if: github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Skip if labeled
        if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-changelog')
        run: echo "Skipping changelog check (skip-changelog label present)"

      - name: Install uv
        if: ${{ !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-changelog') }}
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: ${{ !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-changelog') }}
        run: uv sync --extra dev

      - name: Check changelog
        if: ${{ !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-changelog') }}
        run: uv run just check-changelog origin/${{ github.base_ref }}

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'netlify.toml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'netlify.toml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docs
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Check required files exist
        run: |
          test -f .vitepress/config.ts
          test -f index.md
          test -f favicon.svg

      - name: Build VitePress
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        uses: nwtgck/actions-netlify@v3
        with:
          publish-dir: docs/.vitepress/dist
          production-deploy: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          deploy-message: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message || github.event.pull_request.title }}
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}

name: Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'

jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --extra dev

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: uv run just test-integration

name: Minor Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/publish.yml
    with:
      bump_type: minor
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

concurrency:
  # A superseded gate run polls a stale SHA until it finishes. Cancel it.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  # willfire reads the PR and its changed files to predict which workflows dispatch.
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own (see monitor.ts) -- this is the
    # backstop. If a predicted run never dispatches, the gate waits here
    # until the job is killed.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: thekevinscott/pr-monitor@v1

name: Publish Release

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      bump_type:
        description: 'Version bump type: patch or minor'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write  # Required for PyPI trusted publishing
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get current version
        id: current
        run: |
          latest_tag=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]' | head -n1)

          if [ -z "$latest_tag" ]; then
            echo "No tags found"
            echo "version=0.0.0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "has_tags=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Latest tag: $latest_tag"
            echo "version=${latest_tag#v}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "has_tags=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

            # Check for commits since last tag (for patch releases)
            commits_since_tag=$(git rev-list ${latest_tag}..HEAD --count)
            echo "commits_since_tag=$commits_since_tag" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check for changes (patch only)
        if: inputs.bump_type == 'patch' && steps.current.outputs.has_tags == 'true'
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.current.outputs.commits_since_tag }}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No new commits since last tag, skipping release"
            echo "should_release=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Found ${{ steps.current.outputs.commits_since_tag }} commits since last tag"
            echo "should_release=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Calculate new version
        id: version
        run: |
          current="${{ steps.current.outputs.version }}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$current"

          if [ "${{ inputs.bump_type }}" == "minor" ]; then
            new_version="${major}.$((minor + 1)).0"
          else
            new_version="${major}.${minor}.$((patch + 1))"
          fi

          echo "new_version=$new_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "New version will be: $new_version"

      - name: Check if tag exists
        id: tag_check
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -q "refs/tags/v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}$"; then
            echo "Tag v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} already exists on remote"
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Determine if release should proceed
        id: should_release
        run: |
          # Skip if tag exists
          if [ "${{ steps.tag_check.outputs.exists }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "proceed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # For patch releases, skip if no changes
          if [ "${{ inputs.bump_type }}" == "patch" ] && [ "${{ steps.current.outputs.has_tags }}" == "true" ]; then
            if [ "${{ steps.check_changes.outputs.should_release }}" == "false" ]; then
              echo "proceed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

          echo "proceed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create and push tag
        if: steps.should_release.outputs.proceed == 'true'
        id: tag
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a "v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}" -m "Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin "v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          echo "created=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install uv
        if: steps.tag.outputs.created == 'true'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Build package
        if: steps.tag.outputs.created == 'true'
        run: uv build

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        if: steps.tag.outputs.created == 'true'
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo "Publish attempt $attempt of 3"
            if uv publish --trusted-publishing always --check-url https://pypi.org/simple/; then
              exit 0
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]; then
              echo "Retrying in 15 seconds..."
              sleep 15
            fi
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Rollback tag on failure
        if: failure() && steps.tag.outputs.created == 'true'
        run: git push --delete origin "v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
